heroSub: 5 hand-picked stays around Ang Sila and Khao Sam Muk in Chonburi that we've reviewed in depth — a seaside boutique hotel with a 180-degree rooftop view, a loft-design stay with free bikes, a whole-house pool villa for big groups, a sea-view serviced apartment, and a budget hillside residence. introH2: 🌊 What kinds of stays does the Ang Sila-Khao Sam Muk area have, and how do you pick the right one?
introHtml: Ang Sila is one of Chonburi's old fishing communities that most people just drive through on the way to the fish market and seafood restaurants, then carry on to sleep over on the Bang Saen side — few think to stay the night here, because there aren't many places to stay in the area and each one has a distinctly different character. Some are seaside boutique hotels with a rooftop bistro looking out over a 180-degree view, some are loft-style design stays in the Khao Sam Muk area with bikes you can ride down to the beach, some are whole-house pool villas for big families, and some are sea-view serviced apartments for a few hundred baht. Plenty of people pick the wrong type and find the location or style doesn't match their trip, so it ends up feeling like poor value. This article rounds up 5 stays around Ang Sila and Khao Sam Muk in Chonburi that we've reviewed in depth, both on the Ang Sila seafront and on the Khao Sam Muk hillside — every one comes from reading real guest reviews, telling you both the good points and the honest caveats, comparing prices across 3 sites, with direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Ang Sila has no train line and public transport in the area is limited, so having your own car is the most convenient option. From Bangkok, it's about 1.5 to 2 hours by car via the motorway or Bang Na-Trat, depending on traffic. The neighborhoods covered in this article: Ang Sila seafront — an old fishing community within walking distance of the fish market, the fish pier, and Wat Ang Sila; this is the community's mudflat sea, not a sandy beach. Khao Sam Muk/Saen Suk, Bang Saen-Ang Sila Road — a hillside zone that's quieter than the beachfront, with viewpoints and the Khao Sam Muk monkey troop, about 5–10 min by car or bike from Bang Saen Beach. Every stay in this article has free parking and is a short drive from Bang Saen Beach, Nong Mon Market, and the pier to Koh Sichang.

entries.type: 3-Star Boutique · Ang Sila Seafront + Rooftop Bistro
entries.name: Kroque Boutique & Bistro
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ang Sila seafront · walk to the fish market
entries.addr: 33/3 Moo 5, Bangsaen-Ang Sila Road, Ang Sila, Mueang Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: If there's one stay people think of when they talk about "sleeping over in Ang Sila," many reviews give it to this one — Kroque Boutique & Bistro is a small boutique hotel of just 17 rooms set right on the Ang Sila seafront, open since 2014 and one of the few stays in the area with a top-floor rooftop bistro looking out over a 180-degree sea view, with the fish pier, fishing boats, and Khao Sam Muk as a backdrop. The building is a narrow high-rise with a glass lift carrying you up to the top floor, which turns out to be the real main draw. From reviews on Wongnai, the image that comes up most is sitting down to dinner on the rooftop just as the sun sets over the sea. Rooms are done in a Thai-modern style, and many reviews agree they're more spacious than you'd expect at this price, well-equipped, and have a bathroom with separate wet and dry zones, which is hard to find in stays at this price level. Another thing that makes a good impression from the very first step is the free welcome snacks at check-in, including popcorn, ice cream, and drinks. Honest caveats from the reviews: there's no swimming pool, and Ang Sila is a fishing community's mudflat sea, not a sandy beach for swimming; rooftop food prices are fairly high compared to typical seafood restaurants in the area, some reviews felt certain ingredients weren't as fresh as expected, and because it's a small building, some rooms may not get a full sea view, so specify when booking. This is a stay that sells "experience and location" more than "quantity of amenities," suited to couples and groups of friends who want to spend the night on the Ang Sila seafront in a small, quiet boutique atmosphere, with a pretty rooftop view in the same building.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Head up to the rooftop in the evening into the night for the sunset over the Ang Sila sea. If you want a sea-view room, ask and specify it when booking, because it's a small building and not every room sees the view equally. If you're keeping it cheap, stay here and head down to eat at the Ang Sila fish market instead of the rooftop.

Rooftop bistro with a 180-degree sea view, taking in the fish pier and Khao Sam Muk
Rooms more spacious than the price, separate wet-dry bathroom, well-equipped
Free welcome snacks at check-in, friendly staff

entries.name: Wheeler Bed & Bike
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.3 · TripAdvisor #1 in the Chonburi B&B category
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Bang Saen-Ang Sila Rd · 5–10 min bike to the beach
tags: 🚲 Free bikes to ride to the beach
🏙️ Rooftop pool with Khao Sam Muk view
entries.addr: 32 Bang Saen-Ang Sila Road, Saen Suk, Mueang Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: Among the stays in this area, if you measure by review score, Wheeler Bed & Bike is the highest scorer in this article at around 9.3 on Trip.com, and TripAdvisor ranks it #1 in the guesthouse/B&B category in Chonburi. It's a loft-style design stay on Bang Saen-Ang Sila Road in the Saen Suk area, in the Khao Sam Muk zone, that takes two-wheel culture as a full-on concept — free bikes to use, both single bikes and tandems, with several buildings connected by a bridge you can walk and ride across, and some rooms have a bike rack inside for cyclists who bring their own. The point reviews mention most is the rooftop pool overlooking Khao Sam Muk as a backdrop, followed by Above A Bar, whose cocktails draw praise, and To Die For Coffee, which many reviews say has good coffee and tasty baked goods. Rooms are in an industrial-loft tone — bare concrete, steel, and wood — and many reviews agree they're clean, more spacious than expected, and photogenic from every angle, with several staff praised as being as warm as family. Honest caveats: the rooftop pool is fairly small, more for soaking and photos than serious swimming, and at times reviews complain the water doesn't look clear; restaurant service and the consistency of the Western breakfast options are the most frequently criticized points; the location isn't on the beach so you have to bike or drive a bit farther, and some reviews found their room didn't match the booking, so confirm beforehand. It's best for couples, cyclists, and small groups of friends who want pretty design, peace and quiet, and a rooftop pool with a Khao Sam Muk view, more than families bringing small kids to swim all day.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Grab a free bike and ride along the Saen Suk area down to Bang Saen Beach, or ride to Khao Sam Muk in the morning before the sun gets strong. If you're coming as a group, choosing the Pool Villa with its own private pool is better value than the small shared pool. Plan to bike out to eat at the seafood restaurants around Bang Saen, then use the stay's cafe and bar for a light meal.
pros: Highest score in the article, around 9.3 · TripAdvisor #1 in the Chonburi B&B category
Pretty loft-style design, photogenic from every angle, rooms clean and more spacious than expected
Free bikes to ride down to Bang Saen Beach · rooftop pool + rooftop bar with Khao Sam Muk view
To Die For cafe's coffee and baked goods draw praise, staff as warm as family
cons: Rooftop pool fairly small, water doesn't look clear at times (from reviews)
Restaurant service sometimes slow, Western breakfast options inconsistent
Not on the beach, have to bike or drive a bit · some reviews found their room didn't match the booking

entries.name: Royal Sammuk Villa
entries.revCount: Real reviews across platforms · around 8.4 from 258 reviews
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khao Sam Muk · ~5 min drive down to Bang Saen Beach
tags: 🏊 Some villas have a private pool
entries.addr: 62/6 The Royal Sammuk, Bangsaen-Angsila Road, Saen Suk, Mueang Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: Anyone who's been to Bang Saen-Ang Sila with a big family or a crew of friends knows how much hassle it is to book several hotel rooms to fit everyone, and you don't really end up staying together — so Royal Sammuk Villa is a different kind of option: standalone villa houses on Khao Sam Muk that you rent whole and have comfortably to yourselves. There's a choice from 2 to 3 up to 5 bedrooms, some with a private pool inside the fence, and every villa has a kitchen with equipment, a fridge, a microwave, and a lounge corner. A very popular one is the 3-bedroom villa with a private pool of about 130 sqm, suited to a group of 6–8, and the largest is the 5-bedroom villa of about 175 sqm that takes up to a dozen-plus people. The stay sits on Bang Saen-Ang Sila Road on the Khao Sam Muk side, a hillside zone that's quieter and more private than the beachfront, but still only about a 5-minute drive from Bang Saen Beach and close to the Khao Sam Muk viewpoint and the pier to Koh Sichang. From the reviews, one group of 12 said they rented the 5-bedroom villa and stayed together very comfortably, the kids could play in the house pool all day, and in the evening they ordered seafood to cook in the house kitchen, far better value than booking several rooms. Honest caveats: it's a holiday house, not a luxury hotel — furniture and decor in some villas are starting to show their age, water pressure in some villas is fairly weak, the upkeep of the pool and garden is inconsistent at times, and it's up on the hillside, not on the beach, so you have to drive down to swim. It's best for big families and crews of friends who want to rent a whole house, stay together, cook their own meals, and pay an affordable per-head rate.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Check clearly when booking whether the villa you choose has a private pool, because not every one has a pool of its own. Swing by Ang Sila Market or Nong Mon Market for fresh seafood to cook or grill by the pool. Book direct or ask about available villas by calling 081-615-0999 or via the The Royalsammuk Villa page.

Some villas have a private pool, suited to families with kids

Quiet location on Khao Sam Muk, close to Bang Saen Beach and Ang Sila Market · free parking
cons: Furniture and decor in some villas are starting to show their age (from reviews)

entries.name: Central Place Serviced Apartment Angsila
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.7 · 53 reviews · location 9.6 · TripAdvisor #1 in the Ang Sila B&B category
entries.badge: 🌊 Location 9.6 · sea view for a few hundred baht
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Ang Sila · ~170 m walk to the temple
tags: 💸 From a few hundred baht, clean rooms
entries.storyHtml: Where the other upscale hotels in this area start in the thousands to several thousand, Central Place Serviced Apartment Angsila sells the most straightforward thing of all — a seaside room with the chance of a sea view and a balcony, starting at a few hundred baht, in the middle of Ang Sila's old fishing community. It's a 2-star serviced apartment, a small building of about 20 rooms, open since 2015, located at 100/12 Moo 1, Ang Sila, on the community's seafront. The number-one draw is the location, which scores as high as 9.6 out of 10 in real reviews — it's about a 170-meter walk to Wat Ang Sila, the Ang Sila Market and the fish pier selling fresh seafood are within a 5–10 minute walk, and Tripadvisor ranks it #1 in the B&B/Inn category in Ang Sila. Rooms are split into several types by bed size and view, and the one many people seek out is the Standard Room with Double Bed and Sea View — big bed, sea view. Most real reviews praise the rooms as clean, more spacious than expected, with the building still looking new, and many sum it up simply as "a few-hundred-baht price but a thousand-baht view." Honest caveats: there's no swimming pool and no breakfast included, since it's a budget stay; sound insulation between rooms isn't great and you clearly hear the door of the room next door opening and closing; some in-room items are incomplete, e.g. some rooms have no kettle; and the Ang Sila area has limited public transport, so getting around is easiest when you have a car. It's best for budget travelers, couples on a short stay, and anyone set on coming to eat seafood and enjoy the Ang Sila community way of life on a few-hundred-baht budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: A regular Standard room may not see the sea; specify a Sea View room or a room with a balcony when booking to get the full Gulf of Thailand view. If you're a light sleeper, bring earplugs, since sound insulation isn't great. Walk over to eat fresh seafood at the Ang Sila market and fish pier in just a few minutes.

Sea-view rooms with a balcony at a budget few-hundred-baht price
Clean rooms, building still looks new, comfortable beds
Free Wi-Fi, free parking, airport transfer · shared kitchen in the building
cons: No swimming pool, and no breakfast included (it's a budget stay)
Sound insulation between rooms isn't great, you hear the room next door (from reviews)
Some in-room items are incomplete · limited public transport in the area, easiest with a car

entries.type: Budget Residence · Khao Sam Muk Foothill Residence
entries.name: Charn Residence
entries.revCount: Trip.com 7.9 · 6 reviews · Tripadvisor 3.6/5 · #3 of 7 in Saen Suk subdistrict
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Opposite the Khao Sam Muk approach · beach ~5–10 min by car
tags: 🌊 Upper-floor rooms with sea + mountain view
entries.addr: 32 Bangsaen-Ang Sila Road, Saen Suk, Mueang Chonburi
entries.storyHtml: Closing out with the most budget-friendly option in the article — Charn Residence is a small budget-level residence, a 4-story building of about 20 rooms, open since 2011, that clearly sells two things: a quiet location at the foot of Khao Sam Muk and prices starting in the low thousands. It's located at No. 32 on Bang Saen-Ang Sila Road, right across from the approach up Khao Sam Muk, a stretch of coastal road connecting Bang Saen with Ang Sila that's far quieter and has far less traffic than the main beachfront. The point guests mention most is the upper-floor rooms that see both the sea view and the line of Khao Sam Muk, which is hard to find on a budget in the thousands; most real reviews say the rooms are clean, the beds comfortable, plenty of pillows, and it's quiet, with one guest saying that in the morning they opened the curtains to see the sea and Khao Sam Muk like a real getaway. Another point reviews agree on is the spacious free private parking, easier to park than the beachfront zone where cars pack in on holidays, and the owner has planted grapevines around the building, after the restaurant name The Chardonnay, giving a shady, charming feel. Honest caveats: the building has no lift, so upper-floor rooms mean taking the stairs; the location is off the main tourist spots, taxis are hard to hail and you pretty much need a car; early in the morning there's the sound of dogs and roosters, fitting the suburban hillside setting; the walls in some rooms are thin and you hear the room next door; and at check-in they take a room deposit of around 500 baht, returned at check-out. It's best for people driving their own car who want a budget seaside stay near Bangkok, quiet, with a chance at a sea-view room on a budget in the thousands.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for an upper-floor Deluxe room for the sea and Khao Sam Muk view, but be prepared for no lift and taking the stairs. Have cash ready for the room deposit of around 500 baht at check-in, and check whether the rate you booked includes breakfast. It's a few minutes' drive to the Ang Sila fish pier market to buy fresh seafood at local prices.

Quiet atmosphere at the foot of Khao Sam Muk, good for relaxing
Upper-floor rooms see both the sea view and the line of Khao Sam Muk, hard to find on a budget in the thousands
Spacious free private parking, easy to park · close to Ang Sila seafood

faqTitle: FAQ — questions travelers often ask about Ang Sila stays, Chonburi

faq.q: ❓ What's the best stay in the Ang Sila area, Chonburi?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style. If you want to truly stay the night on the Ang Sila seafront with a rooftop view, Kroque Boutique & Bistro is one of the few boutique hotels right on the sea. If you measure by review score, Wheeler Bed & Bike has the highest at around 9.3 and is TripAdvisor #1 in the Chonburi B&B category. If you're coming as a big group, Royal Sammuk Villa lets you rent a whole house. If you focus on location and a budget price, Central Place Angsila's location scores 9.6. And if you want quiet at the lightest price, Charn Residence.

faq.q: ❓ How much does an Ang Sila stay cost?
faq.a: In this article, prices start at about ฿700–2,400 per night. The most accessible options are Central Place Angsila from ฿700 and Charn Residence from ฿1,000. Mid-range is Kroque from ฿1,468. And the design/villa side is Wheeler from ฿2,250 and Royal Sammuk Villa from ฿2,380 (the larger villas go up into the tens of thousands). All prices are approximate starting prices from standard rooms; during festivals and long holidays prices may be higher than usual.

faq.q: ❓ Does Ang Sila have a sandy beach for swimming?
faq.a: Ang Sila is a fishing community's sea (mudflats), not a sandy beach for swimming. The charm of this area lies more in the old fishing way of life, the fish market, the fish pier, the Ang Sila stone mortars, and the sea view from the stays or rooftops. If you want to swim in the sea, allow time to drive or bike to nearby Bang Saen Beach, about 5–15 minutes away. Stays on the Khao Sam Muk side like Wheeler, Royal Sammuk, and Charn work conveniently as a base for Bang Saen Beach.

faq.q: ❓ Do you need your own car to stay in Ang Sila?
faq.a: We recommend having your own car for the most convenience, because the Ang Sila-Khao Sam Muk area has limited public transport and hailing a taxi or Grab in and out isn't as smooth as in the city. Every stay in this article has free parking. If you don't have a car, Central Place Angsila is the easiest, within comfortable walking distance of Ang Sila's temple, market, and sea, while Wheeler has free bikes to ride around the area. From Bangkok, it's about 1.5 to 2 hours by car depending on traffic.

faq.q: ❓ Which Ang Sila stay is best for families or big groups?
faq.a: The best for big groups is Royal Sammuk Villa, standalone villa houses you rent whole, from 2–5 bedrooms, some with a private pool, and every one has an in-house kitchen to cook your own meals, great value when split among several people. Kroque and Charn suit couples or small groups of friends more, since they're small stays with no swimming pool. Families wanting a pool and a sandy beach for the kids may be better suited to the Bang Saen or Pattaya side.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should you book an Ang Sila stay?
faq.a: Most stays in this area are small (about 17–20 rooms, or a limited number of villas), so they fill up fast. During weekends, long holidays, and events like the Bangsaen Thailand Speed Festival, you should book 2–4 weeks ahead or more, especially Royal Sammuk Villa and Wheeler, where rooms/villas are limited. On ordinary weekdays, booking a few days ahead is enough. We recommend choosing Free Cancellation first if your plans aren't set, then comparing Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price.
